messages:
lina_support: FYI — customers are seeing intermittent 504s + 5xx from hosted inference in us-west-2 over the last ~10m. Spike correlates with several large tenant bursts. Escalating to oncall. Any quick mitigation ideas? :exclamation:
sara_ops: Saw a flurry of requests to generation endpoint, queue depth jumped. Gateway logs show upstream timeouts while pods were still initializing. Putting logs in #eng-sre. :mag:
mike_sre: tagging in. Initial hypothesis: HPA/KEDA didn't kick prewarm replicas fast enough; readiness probes delaying traffic until model init completes -> requests hit gateway timeout. Repro steps?
aj_devops: I pulled scaledobject for affected namespace: scaledObject annotations have pollingInterval: "30" and cooldownPeriod: "300" — looks conservative. Also prewarm annotation missing (we recently added prewarm feature but not enabled for some tenants).
ben_eng: quick check of model init logs: some model variants (quantized 4-bit) are taking ~18-22s to load on cold pod; readiness probe timeout set to 15s. That would cause readiness flapping. Example log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T01:02:12Z model-init: loading model variant x-q4 -> 19073ms
2026-03-17T01:02:33Z kv-cache:init -> 1200ms
2026-03-17T01:02:40Z readiness: probe failed (timeout)
```
sara_ops: deploy-bot shows a burstscale event at 6325554300, keda scaler reported no metrics for 40s during spike (metric server latched).
deploy-bot: [keda] ScaledObject/tenant-45: NoScale -> Active at 6325554310 (reason: queue-length=0->120) :warning:
mike_sre: That sequence explains it — KEDA activation race: metric server delay + HPA cool-down = late scale-up. When pods start, readiness probe too aggressive so they don't accept traffic; gateway waits -> 504s.
aj_devops: Short-term mitigations: 1) increase readiness probe timeout to 40s for heavy models, 2) enable our prewarm annotation for tenant groups with burst SLA, 3) bump pollingInterval to 10s for scaler, 4) temporary route heavy tenants to dedicated pool if available. I'll prepare a patch.
ben_eng: Also propose: change model init path to report readiness only after model warm caches loaded but keep liveness separate. That reduces probe flip. Will open PR.
mike_sre: Can we add an emergency ORCA rule to fallback to a lighter model variant when scale-up latency > Xs? That would reduce 5xx exposure.
sara_ops: Support is prepping customer communication: advising retry/backoff and that we're investigating. Any ETA on mitigation?
aj_devops: Rolling change to scaledObject annotations (enable prewarm=true, pollingInterval=10, cooldownPeriod=60) ready — will apply to us-west-2 staging now, then prod in 5m if metrics look stable.
mike_sre: After patch applied, monitor queue depth, pod ready times, gateway 5xx rate. I'll add temporary alert: gateway_5xx_rate > 2% for 3m -> paging.
ben_eng: PR opened for readiness behavior: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4281 — includes config flag to lengthen probe timeout per model size.
sara_ops: Noted. I'll update customers. Thanks team :thumbsup:
